title: Frame
description: Every WebSocket message: a JSON text frame with its type, an optional id, the id it answers and its data.

type.description: The kind of message (NodeMessage). Unknown types are ignored.

id.description: Set by the sender when an answer refers to it (a say is the id of its turn); unique per connection and sender.

ref.description: The id of the frame this one answers or belongs to.

data.description: The message itself; its schema is given by the type. Null or missing for ping and pong.
